Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). L0·N7069unmasked layer
Weak, low-magnitude neuron with no clear semantics: it peaks on whole-word tokens that begin a new clause or word-stem in mixed/foreign-language text (Czech "opravdu", French "Cette", Russian "Всё", English stems "pron|ounced", "etiquette", "myster|iously"), while short function-word/subword fragments ("hin", " h", "soit", Bengali byte pieces) push it strongly negative — so it mainly discriminates full lexical word-openings from clitic-like subword fragments.
